description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy gravity gadget, a chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A rounded mid grey cylindrical body lying along the axis. At the front a wide off-white collar ring, and in front of it a clear glass ball filled flat bright orange sitting in a short grey socket on the axis. Three thick curved off-white claw prongs grow from the collar, spread evenly around the axis (one at the top, two lower left and lower right), reaching forward around the ball and bending inward at their tips. Around the middle of the body a thick bright orange ring, slightly larger than the body. On top of the body a mid grey carry handle: a straight bar on two legs, arching from just behind the collar to the rear. At the rear a wide round off-white end cap with two short mid grey round pipes pointing straight back, stacked one above the other on the centre line. Underneath at the rear a dark teal handle raked backward, with a bright orange curved finger lever inside a rounded mid grey loop in front of the handle. A bright yellow lever is on the right flank of the body.
proportions: About 0.62 m long, 0.24 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 2.58 : 1 : 1.25)
sides: the bright yellow lever is on the right flank only; the left flank has none; everything else is symmetric left to right (the top prong on the centre line, the two lower prongs mirrored, the two rear pipes stacked one above the other on the centre line).
